redirect.notFoundHint: This code «{code}» does not resolve to any object.

resolve_code.description: Resolve a short label code or scanned value to the object it names (returns the canonical object reference and its display name).

params.value: A label short code (e.g. CMP-4Z9QX), a /c/<code> link, an object reference, or a raw barcode/SKU.

create_label.description: Create (or return the existing) printable label for an object, given its canonical reference. Returns the short code and its deep-link.

delete_label.description: Delete the printable label for an object. The object itself is not affected; only the code mapping is removed.

params.code: The label short code to delete, or the object's canonical reference.

errors.invalidRef: «{ref}» is not a valid object reference.
errors.unresolvableRef: «{ref}» does not name a known object.
